shortDescription: Gathers information about PowerMax or VMAX storage entities

options.name: filters
options.description: List of filters to support filtered output for storage entities. Each filter is a tuple of {filter_key, filter_operator, filter_value}. Supports passing of multiple filters. The storage entities, 'rdf', 'health', 'snapshot_policies' and 'metro_dr_env', does not support filters. Filters are ignored if passed.

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: List of string variables to specify the PowerMax or VMAX entities for which information is required. Required only if the serial_no is present. List of all PowerMax or VMAX entities supported by the module. To get alert summary information - alert. To get health status of a specific PowerMax array - health. To get volumes - vol. To get storage resource pools - srp. To get storage groups - sg. To get port groups - pg. To get hosts - host. To get host groups - hg. To get ports - port. To get maski

options.name: masking_view_name
options.description: The name of the masking view to fetch the masking view connections.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax or VMAX array. It is not required for getting the list of arrays.

options.name: tdev_volumes
options.description: Boolean variable to filter the volume list. This has a small performance impact. The default setting is True and; only TDEV volumes will be returned. True - Returns only the TDEV volumes. False - Rreturns all the volumes.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.
